title: Verify: BootScene has a single SceneObject import unit tests
summary: Unit test reads BootScene.ts source and counts imports
description: Write a unit test that reads the BootScene.ts source from disk and asserts a single SceneObject type import.
acceptance_criteria: Given the source, when matched, then exactly one SceneObject import exists
Given the source, when matched, then no duplicate import line exists
technical_constraints: Only node:fs read of a repo file, no app started

steps.action: Add test `has exactly one import type SceneObject line` that reads ../src/phaser/BootScene.ts with readFileSync and asserts the count of lines matching /^import type \{ SceneObject \}/ equals 1.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneNoDuplicates.test.ts -t 'import'
